jobs.title: Platform
jobs.description: Demand Forecasting: Accuracy Isn't Everything. Forecasting Continuously at Scale Autonomous model selection, fine tuning and training. No proficiency required. Forecasts that Cover More Options There’s a limit to demand accuracy, but predicting uncertainty allows you to prepare for a range of possible futures. Gain clarity on what lies ahead. Enrich with Outside-In Planning Automatically integrate external data sources to enhance your forecast performance, ensuring more informed decision-making. Analyze the Impact of Various Factors Understand key drivers and emerging opportunities in your industry to make smarter, data-backed strategic decisions. Managing Uncertainty: Create Options, Respond Quickly. Anticipate Supply Volatility Plan for variability across suppliers, lead times, and material availability. Build a supply strategy that flexes with real-world constraints. Evaluate the Impact of Disruptions Identify issues before they become problems. Secure production continuity and cost efficiency. Go Beyond Static Planning Evaluate plans through thousands of scenarios, enabling you to build adaptive strategies that navigate uncertainty with confidence. 70% of Decisions are Late! React Fast. Adaptive Scheduling. Stay on Track Continuously monitor changes and dynamically adjusts execution plans to keep delivery timelines intact and customers satisfied. Proactive Decision-Making, Not Reactive Fixes Integrate planning with execution, enabling businesses to anticipate disruptions, adjust sourcing strategies, and reallocate resources before small issues become costly delays. Constraints and Granular Decisions Various constraints and industry specific features, bridging the digital to reality gap. Enabling response. Strategic Portfolio Optimization Reduce Complexity, Maximize Efficiency Simplify your portfolio without disrupting operations. This results in lower costs, improved procurement strategies, and a more agile supply chain. Cross-Functional Collaboration Create a shared, data-driven view of the portfolio. Enabling organizations to align decisions across departments, ensuring that optimizations drive both cost savings and business growth. Plan for Change. Decide with Confidence. jobs.title: About Us
jobs.description: OUR STORY When Supply Chains Broke, We Built Something Better Hexight was founded in the aftermath of COVID, when global supply chain breakdowns exposed how fragile traditional planning systems had become. As engineers who have built and scaled mission-critical systems, we recognized a clear gap: companies were managing billion-dollar operations with outdated tools, unfit for the complexity of today’s world. We built Hexight to change that. Our founding team has worked together for many years in the past, building high-impact systems and applying advanced analytics and AI to solve complex challenges at scale. That shared history created a foundation of deep trust, aligned execution, and technical rigor - the same foundation we now bring to modernizing Sales & Operations Planning. Our world-class team is focused on one mission Equipping manufacturers and distributors with the tools required to stay profitable in a volatile market. We know what you’re going through. We went through it too. We’ve built dozens of manufacturing lines. We’ve been through lockdowns. We’ve had to deal with suppliers being late, closing production lines, and even their facilities catching on fire. We’ve had clients breathing down our necks - and the responsibility was always entirely ours. Only an AI native team can see the full potential From a team who only knows how to live on the cutting-edge - we are at the forefront of practical AI solutions. Our mission is to deliver a new era in automation and decision support, revolutionizing supply chain planning. With a focus on usability and clear decision-making, our solutions are free of old computational limitations, empowering businesses to thrive in the digital age. We know the stakes of running a complex, high-risk, multi-million-dollar supply chain. We understand what it takes. Meet the team Tamar Weiser CEO Yoav Peer VP R&D Netanel Touson VP Solution Oren Hecht VP Technology & Strategic Initiatives Jameson Wachtell Head of US Sales Plan for Change. Decide with Confidence. Use AI-native S&OP to explore better options, align faster across teams, and commit to plans that stay strong in the most volatile situations Get Started

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: Homepage Careers Senior Data Scientist Tel Aviv Full time About Us Hexight is a well funded start-up currently in the seed stage, with an operational product and paying clients, expecting to grow rapidly in the coming years. Hexight specializes in software development for supply chain management, offering solutions that leverage advanced planning and forecasting techniques to help businesses make smarter and faster decisions amidst uncertainty. Our expertise includes demand forecasting, experiment-driven planning, and probabilistic planning/forecasting. Key Responsibilities As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be instrumental in developing and deploying advanced data-driven solutions. Your responsibilities will include: ‍ Designing, developing, and implementing production-grade machine learning models and probabilistic time series analysis models. Analyzing complex datasets to extract actionable insights. Developing and implementing algorithmic solutions to optimization problems. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate ML solutions into the product. Staying up to date on the latest advancements in data science and machine learning, and applying them to our business challenges ‍ Requirements We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated individual who meets the following qualifications: ‍ Experience: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (CS), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related quantitative field with 5+ years of relevant industry experience, or a Master's degree/Ph.D. with 4+ years of experience. Proven experience solving data science problems using tabular data. Strong expertise in Python programming and its core data science libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy). Experience working as part of a team. Ability to learn quickly, including cutting edge technologies and research. ‍ Advantages Candidates with the following experience will be highly regarded: ‍ Proficiency in time series analysis. Experience with optimization problems. Strong foundation in statistical modeling and probability theory. Experience with MLOps practices and tools. Experience with cloud computing infrastructure. Experience with probabilistic forecasting. ‍ Plan for Change. Decide with Confidence.
